sections.title: Mechanics
items: Title: Social / Information Mechanics
Player Safe: Players can interact, comfort, persuade, or earn trust Lausa Standworth when it is present in the fiction.
Gm Only: Use the roll only when the player's method, stakes, and consequence are concrete.
No Roll Reveals: Surface read: Carries a barrel on one shoulder and asks every weapon its name. Give obvious visible facts freely; roll for meaning, risk, leverage, cost, or a hidden angle.

Rolls: entity-lausa-standworth-engage-lausa-standworth entity-lausa-standworth Engage Lausa Standworth Engage Lausa Standworth Presence Knowledge Instinct Presence Knowledge, Instinct 12 Choose the trait from the player's method, not the entity type. A flat read of Lausa Standworth hides the cost, motive, or useful next step. Critical Success: best possible version of the action; gain Hope and clear 1 Stress. Add an extra benefit that follows from the fiction. Success with Hope: the PC gets what they wanted and gains Hope. Keep the position clean or generous. Success with Fear: the PC gets what they wanted, but the GM gains Fear and introduces a cost, complication, or pressure. Failure with Hope: the PC does not get the full result, but gains Hope and receives a useful thread, clue, or safer next option. Failure with Fear: the PC fails and the GM gains Fear. Make a hard move that follows...
Fear Spends: Reveal who benefits from the current situation. Make the cost personal without closing off player agency.
Condition Options: No official condition unless the fiction calls for Hidden, Restrained, or Vulnerable
Search Loot: Can provide food/drink, not loot.

Player Safe: Lausa Standworth a broad-shouldered elder carrying a barrel like it weighs nothing A broad alewife leans over a wooden mug, braid tucked back, forearm tattoo visible, with enough warmth in her smile to make a room confess. Block1: Lausa Standworth LOW-suh STAND-worth a broad-shouldered elder carrying a barrel like it weighs nothing Local authority without official title. Cultural orientation, grounded suspicion, and warm pressure to respect Hush. Lausa rewards respect and shuts down condescension fast. Local stakes Hospitality if treated well A direct read on outsider behavior Practical, suspicious of titles, generous after respect. Name what you need and what you will not take.

Block2: Find out whether the PCs are dangerous, useful, or merely loud. Keep Hush's dignity intact while outsiders keep discovering it as a clue. Find out whether the PCs are dangerous, useful, or merely loud. Keep Hush's dignity intact while outsiders keep discovering it as a clue. Warm enough to make a room confess, shrewd enough to know exactly why it should not. Calls her love irritation because love sounds too soft out loud. Marks who enters town twice and remembers every unpaid kindness. Weapon first, name second? That tells me plenty. Drink after you answer the question. We have survived worse than uniforms and better than promises. She knows older ward stories than she offers at first pour. Young people trading memory for corporate permission. Good questions, paid tabs, careful listening, and someone who notices the old marks. Title-dropping, boot mud on clean boards, and adventurers...

Block3: She expects outsiders to either posture or ask for a shortcut to trust. Honest curiosity and respect for local knowledge land. Bluster shuts the tap. Presence 13 Lausa gives a practical warning and a social opening. She fights socially first: refusal of hospitality, public shame, and calling in neighbors.

Block4: Who is worried, who is pretending not to be, and where outsiders should not push. Keep her local truth concrete; do not make her explain the whole economy. Distrusts every company that calls extraction protection. Protects Hush's dignity against corporate or adventurer framing. Lausa can validate or challenge the party's report choice later. Garrick can connect through warmth; Khari can earn respect through protective restraint. Protective of Fidget, Yera, Halython, and the old stories they each carry differently. npc_images portrait asset
